mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book_rating (book_id, user_id, score, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{bookId}, #{userId}, #{score}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE score = VALUES(score), update_time = VALUES(update_time)
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(AVG(score), 0) AS avgScore, COUNT(*) AS ratingCount FROM book_rating WHERE book_id = #{bookId}
